description:
Activate Life Chisel by sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Life Chisel trigger, gaining 4 life.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Su-Chi enters the battlefield, triggering Carnival of Souls, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
